core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghaffari is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Most forgiving”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghaffari corresponds to the Arabic form غفاري (Arabic nisba of غَفّار (Ghaffār)). Its core sense is of ghaffar (the ever-forgiving). Ghaffari is a nisba (relational) form of غفار (Ghaffār) 'most forgiving', i.e. 'of Ghaffar'. The source gloss 'traveller, wanderer' belongs to a different root (س ف ر / ط و ف) and is not supported. The source records it as feminine; nisba forms are not intrinsically gendered.
